attributes.summary:
Build round — the Quest Log round (App 5). Stage 1 filled the field, card, component and tool lanes bottom-up in one day, then stage 2 shipped the consuming app the same day: **fourteen blocks built or promoted with Specs** (Created At, Updated At, Due Date, Count, Record Status, Task, Note, Subtask-absorbed-into-Task, Status Board, Activity Feed, Tree, Generate, Summarize, Recommend, Archive/Restore Record, Sort, Filter), three already-Done blocks reused (Import, Export, Duplicate, plus Feed/Activity/Board), and **quest-log** landed as the stage-2 POC consuming 19 blocks unchanged — with the Recommend command exercised live from its UI and board drag verified persisting end-to-end.

The crawl itself got three matcher fixes (generic classes, factory-const fields, curated function modules) which recovered **nine silently-missed rows shipped by earlier apps** — the enum status fields of Apps 1/3/4 and the Order Fulfilment Board — on top of the fourteen new ones: 23 sheet rows and 20 realm rows upgraded, all upward.

Coordination flags, not silent fixes: Template and Create are both marked Done by their owner with no artifact or Spec anywhere (see Note/template-row-discrepancy); Start Date and the Tree row's ownership were respected — Tree's generic block was built at Richard's direction with the owner unchanged and org-tree named as the retrofit consumer.

Two platform findings joined the blocker family's theme of the standard-vs-base gap: PercentageField renders nothing for an explicit 0 (noted on the Percentage row), and an instance authored with adoptsFrom name 'default' on a dual-export def fails every save with 'Cannot change card instance type' — silently, which is what a 'dnd does not update' bug report actually was. 28 instances re-pointed at named exports; the convention is now recorded.
